                    ### Question
                    In which of the following pathologies does a multineuropathy occur ?:

                    ### Options

opb. Vasculitis of the vasa nervorum.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Multineuropathy can occur in both Mellitus diabetes and vasculitis of the vasa nervorum. In Mellitus diabetes, chronic hyperglycemia leads to nerve damage and multineuropathy. Vasculitis of the vasa nervorum can also cause multineuropathy due to impaired blood flow to nerves. Evidence paths confirm the relationship between vasculitis and nerve damage, supporting the occurrence of multineuropathy in this condition.
